evidence: The fully opened official ENSG institutional history says INPL was created in 1971 from five grandes écoles. Its current presentation says ENSG is an internal school of Université de Lorraine in the Lorraine INP collegiate structure following the 2012 merger; thus the imported 1990 INPL label is historically plausible and should be preserved. A fully opened current Université de Lorraine doctoral vacancy names the formal specialty Génie des Systèmes Industriels, but that wording is not literally Génie industriel. Its precise equivalence to the user's Industrial Engineering title rule needs deliberate adjudication before counting a route; applicant qualifications that mention génie industriel are not the degree title.

sources.note: Full official school history explicitly dates INPL creation in 1971.
Full current ENSG presentation says internal University of Lorraine school in Lorraine INP collegiate structure since 2012.
Full current 2026 doctoral vacancy labels exact specialty Génie des Systèmes Industriels; master entry condition separately says génie industriel.
